name: Pens — Beers screen
description: Design Graph for a single dark-themed desktop screen of an app whose window title reads 'Pens': a team header, a season beer-consumption summary, a 52-cell season tracker card with legend, a 2x2 stat card grid, and a five-item bottom navigation bar with 'Beers' active. Derived from one static screenshot only; no source, runtime, or interaction evidence was available.
